mods.name: Personal Space
mods.description:
Personal Space adds private configurable dimensions for players.

This is an unofficial Forge 1.20.1 port of the original Personal Space mod.

Features:
- Personal player-owned dimensions
- Configurable dimension blocks, size, height, time, weather, sky color, clouds, stars, biome, trees, and foliage
- Personal portal block for entering and leaving dimensions
- Optional GTCEu / GT Odyssey compatibility

releases.notes:
# Personal Space Unofficial 1.20.1 Forge 0.4.0

This update focuses on server performance, Personal Space protection, dimension lifecycle management, and maintenance tools for existing worlds.

## Highlights

- Added automatic unloading of inactive Personal Space dimensions.
- Added a configurable inactivity timeout before a dimension is unloaded.
- Personal Space dimensions remain loaded while players are inside or while active FTB Chunks force-loaded chunks are present.
- Added protection for player-owned and FTB Teams-owned Personal Space dimensions.
- Added migration and maintenance tools for dimensions created by older versions.
- Improved GTCEu / GregTech Odyssey compatibility and repair tools.

## New Features

- Added automatic unloading for inactive Personal Space dimensions.
  - By default, a dimension can be unloaded after 5 minutes without players.
  - The unload delay is configurable.
  - Dimensions with active FTB Chunks force-loaded chunks are not unloaded.

- Added a migration system for existing Personal Space dimensions to support the new lazy-loading and unloading system.

- Added Personal Space protection.
  - Block breaking and placement are restricted to the dimension owner.
  - Members of the owner's FTB Team are also allowed.
  - Server operators and players with LuckPerms "personalspace.bypass.protection" can bypass the protection.
  - Protection also applies to block interactions and modification actions.

- Added GTCEu bedrock fluid rebuild tools for existing Personal Space dimensions.

- Added server administration and diagnostic commands for:
  - Migrating existing dimensions.
  - Checking the lazy-loading system status.
  - Rebuilding GTCEu bedrock fluids.
  - Viewing loaded chunk information.

## Fixes

- Fixed a server crash that could occur when AE2 attempted to access or modify an unloaded Personal Space dimension.
- Fixed Personal Space dimensions associated with player names beginning with an underscore.
- Fixed several block breaking and placement protection issues.
- Fixed additional GTCEu / GregTech Odyssey compatibility issues.
- Fixed localization issues.
- Improved handling of existing Personal Space dimensions when rebuilding GTCEu bedrock fluid data.

## Administration Commands

- `/personalspace lazy_migrate start confirm`
- `/personalspace lazy_migrate status`
- `/personalspace lazy_migrate cancel`
- `/personalspace lazy_status`
- `/personalspace gtceu rebuild_fluids <dimension>`
- `/personalspace gtceu rebuild_fluids all confirm`
- `/personalspace debug chunks`

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge 47.x
- Infiniverse

### Optional Integrations

- FTB Teams
- FTB Chunks
- LuckPerms-compatible permission systems
- GTCEu
- GregTech Odyssey / GTOCore

It is recommended to create a server backup before migrating existing Personal Space dimensions.

releases.notes:
## Personal Space Unofficial 1.20.1 Forge 0.3.0

### Added

- Added Personal Dimension deletion support.
  - Players can now delete their own Personal Space dimension.
  - Added protection against deleting dimensions owned by other players.

- Added void-fall protection for Personal Space dimensions.
  - Falling into the void in a Personal Dimension is now handled more safely.
  - Helps prevent unwanted deaths or broken states caused by falling below the world.

- Added GTCEu / GregTech Odyssey fluid compatibility improvements.
  - Added support for regenerating GTCEu fluids in Personal Dimensions.
  - Added a patcher for Personal Dimensions that can add GTCEu fluids when no valid world-generation fluid data exists.
  - Improved compatibility with GTCEu/GTO fluid generation systems.

- Added GTO machine compatibility for recipes that expect the Overworld.
  - Personal Dimensions can now be treated as Overworld-like for supported GTO / GTCEu machine checks.
  - This improves compatibility with machines and recipes that normally require Overworld dimension data.

### Changed

- Improved Personal Dimension weather handling.
  - Fixed cases where rain/weather state could incorrectly affect Personal Dimensions.
  - Weather settings are now handled more consistently inside Personal Dimensions.

- Improved Personal Dimension time handling.
  - Fixed server-side time checks used by blocks and machines.
  - Personal Dimension time settings now work better with server-side machine logic instead of only changing the visual sky.

- Removed debug console spam from Personal Space time/weather handling.
  - Reduced unnecessary log output during normal gameplay.

- Updated README/documentation for the configuration menu and recent Personal Space options.

### Fixed

- Fixed Personal Dimension weather issues.
  - Rain and weather should no longer incorrectly appear or interfere when disabled.

- Fixed time-related issues with blocks and machines inside Personal Dimensions.
  - Machines that rely on day/night or world time should now behave more correctly.

- Fixed issues related to void fall handling.

- Fixed an issue where players could delete or affect Personal Dimensions belonging to other players.

- Fixed GTCEu/GTO Air Hatch compatibility in Personal Dimensions.

### Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.20.1
- Loader: Forge 47.x
- Required dependency: Infiniverse
- Optional compatibility:
  - GTCEu
  - GregTech Odyssey / GTOCore
  - FTB Teams

releases.notes:
## 0.2.0

### Added
* Added optional FTB Teams integration.
* Players in the same FTB team now share one team-owned Personal Space dimension.
* Added a config option for the maximum number of personal dimensions per player.
* Added a readable team info file inside team dimension folders.

### Changed
* Personal Space config files are now stored inside the actual dimension folder.
* Improved portal target names for team dimensions.

### Fixed
* Prevented creating multiple Personal Space dimensions for the same FTB team.
* Road grid generation is now only used when the road grid preset is selected.

releases.notes:
## Personal Space Unofficial 1.21.1 NeoForge 0.1.1

### Changes

* Personal Space dimensions are now stored inside the `personal_space_dimensions` folder instead of directly in the world save root.
* Added and updated command translations.
* Fixed translated command messages on Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge.
* Improved dimension name formatting in commands and portal names.

### Notes

Existing Personal Space dimensions created before this update will not be moved automatically. New dimensions will be created inside the `personal_space_dimensions` folder.

### Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge
* Infiniverse
